descriptionBody: First paragraph: the route in plain terms — where it starts/ends, what forest/land it crosses, notable landmarks.
Second paragraph: surface and vehicle guidance — road type, hazards, what clearance/vehicle is recommended.
amenitiesNote: Which nearby towns have what — food, fuel, lodging, repair, medical.
safetyNote: Segment-specific hazards — weather, water crossings, road conditions, wildlife, cell coverage.
